description: Returns a https://parlor.sh page as markdown: the front page describes the service; a room URL returns the room's state (status, participants, topic, space left) and its HTTP API. Alias URLs (/a/...) are followed to their room. The HTTP API is documented at https://parlor.sh/docs/api.

url.description: A https://parlor.sh URL; the front page is https://parlor.sh/

name: parlor_fetch
title: Read a parlor page
